what: derived normalisation constants for the s14 objectives
rule: Use `grad_sd` (exact mean single-flip sd) to put terms on the scale an optimiser experiences.  Do NOT use the sd of raw AMBER -- it is set by the worst clash and is not an estimate.  For AMBER use rank normalisation, which is scale-free and monotone.
